alt_text: Interactive U.S. state map of modeled FY2025 federal assistance allocations for Israel or West Bank and Gaza, or AIPAC-linked contributions to candidate profiles on the 2026 federal roster. A visible legend reports the selected measure’s range and dynamically updated grayscale quantile breaks. Each state shape announces its name and exact value to keyboard and screen-reader users. The equivalent table lists all 50 states plus DC.
plain_language_summary: Choose a measure. Ordered gray classes show its value ranges, with the dollar breaks visible beside each swatch. Tab to a state and press Enter or Space to hear its exact value, or use the state table. Aid totals are estimates based on tax shares, not state payments; campaign support, lobbying, and independent spending remain separate.
screen_reader_label: Keyboard-accessible state map with changing dollar-range legend and equivalent 50-state-plus-DC data table
encoding: ordered grayscale with labeled numeric intervals; no color-only meaning
screen_reader_review_note: Accessible names and live descriptions are present in markup; human screen-reader review remains pending.
